    The shadow functor Γ : K(Q) ⥤ D(Rep k I) #

    Killing the adjoined object L gives an additive functor κ : Q ⥤ Rep k I extending ι₀ : Q₀ ⥤ Rep k I along e₀ : Q₀ ⥤ Q. The induced triangulated functor Γ = κ ⋙ Qh : K(Q) ⥤ D(Rep k I) restricts to the comparison functor G on K(Q₀).
